An IMSI catcher (cell-site simulator) impersonates a legitimate cellular base station. This app cannot conclusively prove one is present; it flags unusual cell identity, radio generation, signal, neighbor-cell and transition patterns for defensive review.

Privacy: no INTERNET permission. Live monitoring runs only while the app is visible. Scan history and baselines are encrypted with an Android Keystore-backed AES-GCM key. Screenshots are blocked. Reports are generated locally and leave the device only when you explicitly share them.
